title: Design System: Dionysus — The Suspended Pour

display.purpose: Keepsake cocktail title and hero headline. Playfair Display.

headline.purpose: Every line the experience speaks: questions, poles, whispers. Playfair Display italic, black text-shadow underlay over footage.

label.purpose: Brass uppercase tracked labels — keepsake sections and threshold pill only, never generic section eyebrows.

shadows.name: ink-raised
shadows.purpose: Paper-world primary button lift; the only drop shadow family allowed.

shadows.name: ink-pill-active
shadows.purpose: Selected pill in the paper world.

shadows.name: seed-glow
shadows.purpose: The mote/ember double glow — hierarchy in the depths is luminosity, not shadow.

shadows.name: glass-inner
shadows.purpose: Glass-sphere bubbles: inner shoulder highlight plus faint warm halo.

motion.name: ease-arrival
motion.purpose: Default entrance and hover easing everywhere (expo-out).

motion.name: ease-glide
motion.purpose: Camera moves and focus racks in the Surfacing.

motion.name: ease-descent
motion.purpose: Sinking exits — the descent into the drink, bubble fizz.

motion.name: drift
motion.purpose: Idle suspension: every floating element drifts on its own current.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Paper-world primary action: solid sumi ink pill on paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: #16140f; color: #f4efe6; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -10px rgba(22,20,15,0.5); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { transform: scale(1.04); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgba(22,20,15,0.6); } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8702a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Veil Button
components.description: Depths-world continue/seal: a ghost pill that earns its visibility.
components.css: .ds-veil-bg { background: #0d0b09; padding: 28px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-btn-veil { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.6rem 1.9rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,234,216,0.78); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.4s, background 0.4s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-btn-veil:hover { border-color: rgba(255,176,136,0.6); background: rgba(255,176,136,0.08); } .ds-btn-veil:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-veil:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8702a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Choice Pill
components.description: Paper-world selectable option; inverts to solid ink when chosen.
components.css: .ds-pill-row { background: #f4efe6; padding: 20px; display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-pill { padding: 0.6rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid rgba(22,20,15,0.28); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(244,239,230,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); color: #16140f; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: #16140f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-pill:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill-active { background: #16140f; color: #f4efe6; border-color: #16140f; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px -8px rgba(22,20,15,0.55); }

components.name: Ink Input
components.description: Boxless underlined field; the user writes in the experience's own italic hand.
components.css: .ds-input-bg { background: #f4efe6; padding: 24px 28px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 12px; min-width: 280px; } .ds-ink-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(22,20,15,0.3); padding: 0.65rem 0.1rem; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.2rem; color: #16140f; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-ink-input::placeholder { color: rgba(22,20,15,0.32); } .ds-ink-input:focus { border-bottom-color: #16140f; }

components.name: Depth Input
components.description: The same underlined hand, in the dark world: centered, ember caret, glowing focus.
components.css: .ds-depth-bg { background: #0d0b09; padding: 28px 32px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 12px; min-width: 320px; } .ds-depth-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,235,200,0.3); padding: 0.65rem 0.25rem; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.5rem; text-align: center; color: #f5ead8; caret-color: #ffb088; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.4s, text-shadow 0.4s; } .ds-depth-input::placeholder { color: rgba(245,234,216,0.3); } .ds-depth-input:focus { border-bottom-color: rgba(255,176,136,0.75); text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,176,136,0.35); }

components.name: Lens Bubble
components.description: Signature glass sphere: a floating translucent orb holding a choice.
components.css: .ds-lens-bg { background: #0d0b09; padding: 30px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-lens { position: relative; width: 140px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 16px; text-align: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(245,234,216,0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(255,235,200,0.22); background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,0.16) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 42%, rgba(255,235,200,0.07) 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 14px rgba(255,235,200,0.1), 0 0 24px -8px rgba(255,176,136,0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.45s, box-shadow 0.45s; } .ds-lens:hover { transform: scale(1.1); border-color: rgba(255,176,136,0.65); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 18px rgba(255,235,200,0.16), 0 0 38px -6px rgba(255,176,136,0.45); }

components.name: Seed Drop
components.description: The colour choice: a glass droplet with the seed colour glowing inside it, its name surfacing on hover.
components.css: .ds-seed-bg { background: #0d0b09; padding: 34px 40px 48px; display: inline-block; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-seed { position: relative; width: 54px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 38%, rgba(255,235,200,0.35)); cursor: pointer; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 26%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 16%, transparent 38%), radial-gradient(circle at 50% 58%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 72%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 28%, transparent) 52%, transparent 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 40%, transparent), inset 0 -6px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 0 22px -9px var(--c); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.4s, border-color 0.4s; } .ds-seed:hover { transform: scale(1.16); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 65%, rgba(255,245,225,0.55)); box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 58%, transparent), 0 0 36px -5px var(--c); } .ds-seed-label { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 10px); left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); white-space: nowrap; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; color: #f5ead8; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.35s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-seed:hover .ds-seed-label { opacity: 1; }

narrative.northStar: The Speakeasy Behind the Fortune Teller's Parlor
narrative.overview: Dionysus is one continuous pour told in two materials — ink on paper above the surface, light in dark liquid below (the "Water & Ink" identity). The landing world is warm paper, sumi ink, and a vermilion seal: a printed invitation. The journey world is near-black liquid where everything luminous — candlelight ivory text, glass bubbles, seed-coloured motes — floats against darkness. Nothing in the journey is a card, a panel, or a box: interface elements are bubbles, drops, motes, rings, and underlined lines of handwriting, suspended in the dark.
keyCharacteristics: Two worlds, one voice: warm paper above, candlelit depths below
Darkness is the canvas; light (and her seed colour) is the paint
Circles and pills only — no rectangles, no cards
Motion is choreography: every hold has an entrance, a breath, and an exit
The seed colour threads the journey via --c — always as light, never as surface tint

rules.name: The Seed Colour Rule
rules.body: Her colour appears only as light — motes, glows, ripples, ember rims, and the inked lettering of her name. Never a background, never a tint over imagery, never a fill on a panel.

rules.name: The Sacred Glass Rule
rules.body: The 132 persona images are never tinted, graded, or colour-mixed. Colour may sit beside the glass, never on it.

rules.name: The Darkness Rule
rules.body: In the depths, darkness makes the light pop: raise contrast by darkening the surround, never by flattening the palette. Text over the dark world always carries a black text-shadow underlay.

rules.name: The Italic Voice Rule
rules.body: If the interface is saying something to her, it is Playfair italic. If it is labelling something, it is Inter. Never mix the two jobs in one line.

rules.name: The Light-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: To bring an element forward in the depths, make it glow brighter or sit on a darker pool — never give it a drop shadow.

dos: Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every hold — each animation needs its static or near-instant counterpart, including canvas effects
Do keep text over footage legible with the black text-shadow underlay and pool-of-night backing on bright bands
Do drive all seed-coloured styling through the --c custom property
Do ease with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), or the 0.22/0.61/0.36/1 glide for camera moves — never bounce, never elastic
Do use playUntil(target, then) for journey footage — native 1× play, freeze on arrival
donts: Don't build anything resembling a flat, SaaS-style dashboard — no cards, no panels, no boxes
Don't use cartoonish or childish magic — no wizard hats, no bright neon; magic here is candlelight and ink
Don't lay out results as a cliché generic cocktail menu; the keepsake is an apothecary reading
Don't go clinical or overly minimal stark-white; even the splash white is warm
Don't tint, grade, or colour-overlay the persona images — seed colour is lettering and light only
Don't slow, scrub, or variable-rate the journey video, ever
Don't show chapter labels or numbers — the journey reads as one continuous experience
Don't redesign the hero/landing — it is locked and loved
Don't add drag interactions; every depth interaction is a click/touch
Don't use pure #000 or pure #fff anywhere; both worlds are warm
